claims.text: The city has received an application to build two mixed-use towers, one 55 and one 40 storeys tall, at 10, 20, and 36 York Mills Road.

sources.quote: The application proposes to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law 569-2013 to facilitate the development of two mixed-use towers with heights of 55 and 40 storeys.

claims.text: The application asks to change the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to allow the towers.
